name: Jehovahs Witnesses
overview: Scripture reveals that true witnesses of God are those chosen to know, believe, and proclaim Him as the only true God, as Isaiah 43:10 emphasizes. The gospel of the kingdom is to be preached worldwide as a witness to all nations before the end comes (Matthew 24:14), and believers are commissioned to make disciples in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit (Matthew 28:19). The unity of Jesus with the Father (John 10:30) and the eternal life found in knowing the only true God and Jesus Christ (John 17:3) affirm the divine nature of Christ, contrasting with any teaching that denies His deity, as John 1:1 clearly states that the Word was God from the beginning.
